name: COMPLETE SPORTS AND MANAGEMENT
about: Complete Sports and Management India Limited engages in the sourcing, trading, and distribution of various amusement and leisure equipment. Its product portfolio includes bowling solutions, arcade games, soft play areas and indoor play structures, trampoline parks, laser tag systems, bumper cars, go-karting systems, debit card and cashless gaming systems, and related spares, consumables, and accessories. The company also provides installation, commissioning, maintenance, and related consulting services in India, Indonesia, Nepal, Singapore, and Sri Lanka. It serves family entertainment centres, clubs, hotels, resorts, corporate clients, and residential developments across India, the SAARC region, and internationally, including Southeast Asia and Malaysia. Complete Sports and Management India Limited was incorporated in 2002 and is based in Mumbai, India.
